The United States has been mobilizing a global response to address both the perils and opportunities of artificial intelligence. Together with our partners, we’ve developed a global consensus for AI, and now we’re building upon it.

In @StateDeputySpox Patel's final Week at State, @SecBlinken continues travel to Iraq, then to Jordan, discussing support for the Syrian people with regional partners. Later, in New York, he participates in @UN Security Council sessions on Sudan and artificial intelligence.

Additionally, we are mobilizing over $100 million in public and private resources with leading AI developers to support computer access, skills training, and datasets for partners in developing countries.
The United States and 58 other partners have endorsed rules of the road for the responsible use of AI and autonomy in the military domain.

The United States forged global consensus on the critical importance of safe, secure, and trustworthy AI for sustainable development through the first-ever @UN General Assembly resolution on AI, co-sponsored by 122 other countries and adopted by consensus.
The United States and our @G7 allies developed the first-ever multilateral framework for developers of advanced AI systems, called the Hiroshima AI Process Comprehensive Policy Framework.

At the dawn of the AI revolution, the United States led the way in establishing the rules of the road. We’ve demonstrated how AI can be safe, secure, and trustworthy, while also unlocking opportunities to solve the world’s greatest challenges.
.@SecBlinken recently chaired a @UN Security Council meeting on the impact artificial intelligence could have on international peace and security. Here's what you need to know.🧵

There is no military solution. Now is the time to catalyze broader international action to prevent atrocities.

Sudan’s people need safe access to humanitarian assistance, including by enabling humanitarian corridors to allow the delivery of aid and movement of civilians.

Despite heroic efforts by humanitarian workers, vital aid delivery has been obstructed by both the warring parties.

The people of Sudan desperately need an immediate end to the fighting.

After 20 months of fighting that has devastated agricultural production, destroyed market systems, displaced 12 million people, and obstructed humanitarian operations, Sudan is now facing the worst levels of acute food insecurity ever recorded in the country.

Conflict broke out between Sudanese Armed Forces (SAF) and the paramilitary Rapid Support Forces (RSF) on April 15, 2023.

UN Security Council resolutions on Sudan have since called for a cessation of hostilities and for full, rapid, safe, and unhindered humanitarian access.

Sudan’s civil war has brought about the world’s largest humanitarian crisis—over 30 million people are in desperate need of emergency assistance.

As @SecBlinken joins @UN Security Council debate on Sudan this week, here's what you need to know. 🧵

.@SecBlinken spoke to the press before departing Baghdad. He reiterated that the U.S. is determined to work with Iraq on its security and its sovereignty amid the impact that the events in Syria will have. He emphasized that it’s critical that we all support the Syrian people as they emerge from years of the Assad regime’s dictatorship.

@SecBlinken The Secretary then flew to Baghdad to meet with Iraqi Prime Minister Mohammed Shiaa al-Sudani. The U.S. is committed to our strategic partnership with Iraq and to its security, stability, and sovereignty.

The day began in Ankara, where the Secretary met with Turkish Foreign Minister Fidan to discuss the latest on Syria. @SecBlinken reaffirmed U.S. support for a Syrian-led and Syrian-owned political transition to an accountable and inclusive government.

.@SecBlinken wrapped the second day of his trip, taking him from Türkiye to Iraq.

Here’s a recap. ⤵️
The United States supports an inclusive, Syrian-led transition to an accountable and representative government.

The Syrian people will decide the future of Syria. The United States reaffirms its full support for a Syrian-owned political transition, which must include clear commitments to fully respect the rights of vulnerable communities and prevent Syria from being a base for terrorism.

Our @NATO Ally Türkiye is a key partner in developing a peaceful future for Syria.

During a meeting in Ankara, @SecBlinken and President Erdogan discussed the latest developments in Syria and U.S.-Turkish regional cooperation.

@KingAbdullahII @AymanHsafadi Before he departed Jordan, @SecBlinken told the press the focus of his trip is to help coordinate efforts across the region to support the Syrian people as they transition away from Assad’s brutal dictatorship. https://t.co/f01nYiB1en

The U.S. is also committed to supporting the stability of Syria’s neighbors, including Jordan, during this period of transition.

In Aqaba, the Secretary met with Jordanian @KingAbdullahII and Foreign Minister @AymanHsafadi to discuss developments in Syria and our efforts to secure peace in the region.

Today @SecBlinken traveled to Jordan and Türkiye to discuss the situation in Syria. The United States, working alongside partners, will help support an inclusive, Syrian-led transition to an accountable and representative government. 🧵

Anti-corruption champions shine a light on truth and accountability. Today, we honor those who work for transparency, justice, and integrity worldwide. To hear more about our other champions, watch the full ceremony here: https://t.co/txABUYSsyM

Champion Lt. Col. Jorge Mora Cortes of Colombia is the head of the Anti-Corruption Investigation Office of the Colombian National Police and worked hard to dismantle the largest trade-based money laundering ring in Columbia. Due to his work, he was forced to relocate his family.

Sevinj Vagifgizi of Azerbaijan is currently being unjustly detained for writing news stories concerning illegal tenders to companies controlled by government officials and investigating officials in order to expose public funds embezzlement.

Dr. Srbuhi Galyan has helped Armenia use asset forfeiture as an effective anti-corruption tool, with 2024 anti-corruption cases leading to over $1.5 billion in forfeitures and eight settlement agreements returning over $12 million to Armenia.

This week @SecBlinken recognized 10 champions who have demonstrated leadership, courage, and impact in preventing, exposing, and combating corruption. We reaffirm our commitment to all those working to build transparency and accountability around the world.

This week at State, @POTUS travels to Angola to spotlight how U.S. infrastructure investments are connecting southern Africa to the global economy. And @SecBlinken travels to Belgium for meetings with @NATO Foreign Ministers, followed by Malta for @OSCE meetings.
Putin time and again has sought to break Allied resolve as well as the resolve of the Ukrainian people. It hasn’t happened. It won’t happen.
The United States is expanding our relationship all across Africa — from assistance to aid to investment to trade — moving from patrons to partners to help bridge the infrastructure gap. – @POTUS

We know the challenges that define our age demand African leadership. One out of every four human beings on Earth will live in Africa by the year 2050. And the ingenuity and determination of young Africans in particular … will be undeniable forces in that human progress. – @POTUS

Learn more about how the U.S. partnership with Angola is bringing major investments in transportation, clean energy, and other projects that will spur economic growth for both nations. https://t.co/LZYles6gU9
Upgraded logistics networks will make it easier to move items like seeds and fertilizers to farms and finished products to markets.
Using the Corridor will reduce the time goods spend in transit, minimizing spoilage, and boost farmers’ incomes by ensuring more fresh produce reaches the market.
The Lobito Trans-Africa Corridor will attract investments in agribusiness, including processing facilities and storage units, boosting the value chain for agricultural products.
By linking the Atlantic and Indian oceans, the Lobito Trans-Africa Corridor will open new export routes, giving farmers access to new markets.
A more direct route to ports and markets reduces transportation times and helps farmers get their produce to customers faster.

Through the Partnership for Global Infrastructure and Investment, the U.S. is helping expand the Lobito Trans-Africa Corridor. This transformative economic corridor, anchored in core rail investments, is spurring economic growth and revitalized trade routes for the region.

Finally, in a meeting with civil society members from Ukraine, Azerbaijan, Belarus, and Russia, @SecBlinken praised the role of civil society in holding governments accountable and preserving, defending, and protecting basic human freedoms.

At #OSCEMC24, the Secretary’s remarks noted that @OSCE embodies the highest standards of democracy, human rights, the rule of law and, despite Russia’s attempts to obstruct their work, the OSCE continues to carry out its mission.

@SecBlinken While on travel, the Secretary often stops to thank the staff and families that breathe life into our embassies and consulates. At @usembmalta, @SecBlinken recognized the work they do to strengthen U.S.-Malta ties and deepen friendships between our peoples.

With Malta as the host of this year’s OSCE Ministerial, @SecBlinken began his trip with a meeting with Malta’s leadership. The Secretary and Maltese Prime Minister Abela reaffirmed the partnership and friendship between the United States and Malta.

After diplomatic engagements with @NATO Allies in Brussels this week, @SecBlinken was off to Malta to attend the @OSCE Ministerial Council meeting.

Here’s a recap.

In the past four years, the @NATO Alliance has undertaken the most significant reforms and the most significant strengthening that we’ve seen in decades.

NATO is bigger, it’s stronger, it’s better resourced to meet the challenges ahead.

A stronger @NATO means more capabilities to deter aggression, more effective Allies to meet more complex challenges, and the peace and stability that allows our people to pursue fuller lives. — @SecBlinken

When we all talk about this powerful desire to avoid conflicts, to prevent wars, to have peace, the best way to do that is through ongoing investment in the world’s most successful defensive Alliance, and that is NATO. — @SecBlinken

The U.S. and our @G7 partners want people everywhere to thrive. That means helping friends in emerging markets develop what they need to participate in the global economy. And its why we launched the Partnership for Global Infrastructure and Investment. https://t.co/xlR5iRk9M0

For 75 years, @‌NATO has served as a shield against aggression, facilitating governments and society in achieving a fuller and happier life for all our citizens. Learn how NATO’s contributions have contributed to our daily lives. https://t.co/kVlBy9DYoY

At the heart of NATO is a commitment from each Ally to come to the defense of any other Ally. That means that a would-be aggressor knows that if they pick a fight with one, they pick a fight with all.
